question:
The following bar diagram shows the number of students who opted for the different subjects in the year 2020 and 2021. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b86360ffca97f388c68dea574aec21ea5545f315be23897798483ba7a00f6861.png] 

Out of all 5 subjects, what percentage (rounded up to two decimals) of students opted for Biology in 2021?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total student is 2021 is 85 + 90 + 65 + 110 + 75 = 425

Biology opted by 90 students

So required percentage,

⇒ (90/425) × 100 = 21.18%

**∴ The correct option is 3**
